message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with a white background and red borders. At the top, the large red serif word "TEMPO" is centered. Above it, smaller gray text reads "INVESTIGASI: PENIPUAN KLINIK ‘HERBAL’ CINA" on the left and "KATINONA RAFFI AHMAD" on the right. Below the title, "EDISI 4-10 FEBRUARI 2013" is printed in small black letters.

The central image features a cow with black and white patches. The cow is positioned in profile, facing left, with its four legs visible. It holds a cluster of pinkish-red paper bills in its mouth. On the cow's side, within a large black patch, there is a white graphic consisting of two crescents facing away from each other with a stylized stalk of grain between them.

The bold black text "SUAP" and "SAPI BERJANGGUT" is stacked above the cow. At the bottom left, there is a barcode, the price "RP 29.700", and additional publication details including "WWW.TEMPO.CO" and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273". A thin red bar runs along the very bottom edge.
